# In-scope repositories for STOOGE static analysis, one per line.
# These are the repos whose C# we own: the fourteen new STOOGE services plus the
# two upstream forks we have modified. Reference-only upstream clones
# (openrmf-msg-score, openrmf-msg-audit, openrmf-api-compliance,
# openrmf-api-controls) and the superseded pre-v1.8 split services
# (openrmf-api-upload, openrmf-api-save) are deliberately absent: we do not edit
# them, so analyzing them would report other people's debt as ours.
openrmf-api-conmon
openrmf-api-inventory
openrmf-api-journal
openrmf-api-oscal
openrmf-api-poam
openrmf-api-ppsm
openrmf-api-read
openrmf-api-scanhistory
openrmf-api-tasks
openrmf-msg-inventory
openrmf-msg-journal
openrmf-msg-poam
openrmf-msg-reports
openrmf-svc-notify
openrmf-svc-scanwatch
openrmf-svc-trivy
